mapper.sql: FROM drama_shot s JOIN drama d ON d.id = s.drama_id AND d.deleted = 0 JOIN drama_scene sc ON sc.id = s.scene_id AND sc.drama_id = s.drama_id AND sc.deleted = 0 JOIN drama_episode ep ON ep.id = s.episode_id AND ep.id = sc.episode_id AND ep.drama_id = s.drama_id AND ep.deleted = 0 WHERE s.deleted = 0

AND (s.shot_group_id IS NULL OR EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM drama_shot_group g WHERE g.id = s.shot_group_id AND g.deleted = 0 AND g.drama_id = s.drama_id AND g.episode_id = s.episode_id AND g.scene_id = s.scene_id ))
FROM drama_scene sc JOIN drama d ON d.id = sc.drama_id AND d.deleted = 0 JOIN drama_episode ep ON ep.id = sc.episode_id AND ep.drama_id = sc.drama_id AND ep.deleted = 0 WHERE sc.deleted = 0
mapper.select:
SELECT d.id, d.title, d.genre, d.status, d.synopsis, d.aspect_ratio FROM drama d WHERE d.deleted = 0
AND (d.id IN #{projectId}
OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM mcp_business_operation op WHERE op.drama_id = d.id AND op.created_project = 1 AND op.status = 'SUCCEEDED') )
AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM mcp_business_operation op WHERE op.drama_id = d.id AND op.created_project = 1 AND op.status = 'SUCCEEDED')
AND 1 = 0
AND d.title LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') ORDER BY d.sort_order, d.id

SELECT k.* FROM res_keyframe k WHERE k.deleted = 0
AND k.drama_id = #{dramaId} AND (k.drama_id IS NULL OR k.drama_id = 0)
AND (k.shot_id IS NULL OR EXISTS ( SELECT 1 AND s.id = k.shot_id AND s.drama_id = k.drama_id )) AND k.name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') ORDER BY k.sort_order, k.id
